name: bellmux-slides
description: Marp slides introducing bellmux (tmux x coding agents notification CLI)

scripts.diagrams: for d in overview scenario1 scenario2; do mmdc -i diagrams/$d.mmd -o images/$d.svg -p diagrams/puppeteer.json -c diagrams/mermaid.json -b transparent; done
